description.es: Three Monkeys es una cafetería de especialidad en Cusco. La identidad visual parte de un lettering manual y orgánico, inspirado en las ramas del cafeto, que junto a las ilustraciones aporta un carácter expresivo a la marca.
description.en: Three Monkeys is a specialty coffee shop in Cusco. Its visual identity is built around hand-drawn, organic lettering inspired by the branches of the coffee plant, complemented by illustrations that bring an expressive character to the brand.
